description:
Found/split in s494p (perf round 35, #2098 member 4).  Reproducer (perl 5.40.3 linear, PCL quadratic):
    my %h; $h{k} .= "ab" for 1 .. 200000; print length $h{k}, "\n";     # probed s498: perl 0.00 s, PCL (60ca4ae0) 22.5 s wall
    our $g; $g .= "ab" for 1 .. 200000; print length $g, "\n";
Shapes table AFTER s494p (append-shapes.pl, N=50k then 200k): `$h{k} .= "ab"` 0.84 s -> 18.76 s (x22.4), `our $g .= "ab"` 0.90 -> 19.03 (x21.2).
The design question and the census are in #2098 (=== THE GENERAL-PATH CENSUS (s494p) ===): an in-place append is safe only under an ownership invariant (one slot owns an adjustable buffer; every retaining store takes a simple-string snapshot).  Step order ruled by the census: (1) #2111 first (the in-memory FH already breaks the invariant); (2) a non-simple-string test in the p-box CONSTRUCTOR + %p-storable-raw + ONE hash-key helper, cost MEASURED (box-set's fast path alone: +0.4 ns / string store, ~8 %); (3) an audit mode (assert at each retaining store) run over gate + sweep + everyday until green; only then the general `p-.=` appends in place.  Do NOT ship (3)'s append before (3)'s audit is green: it is a program-wide #2111.

=== DONE (s507p, perf round 39; resumed s508 and s509) ===
Shipped in the RULED order of the #2098 census:
(a) every RETAINING store keeps a SIMPLE string: make-p-box (a simple-string clause; the snapshot arm only for a non-simple string), box-set (fast path takes simple strings; the general arm snapshots), %p-storable-raw, ONE hash-key helper %p-hash-key, bless's class name.  STOP RULE: PASSED (scratch/s507p/BENCH-TABLE.md, second measurement): the one real cost was a PRODUCER -- readline handed out its adjustable buffer (40,000 snapshot copies for fhread N=20, 0 after); a reused line buffer then made fhread -20 % against the base.
(b) PCL_STRBUF_AUDIT=<file> logs each snapshot the two copy arms take (zero cost off).  On the final tree (bc276159) the file was NEVER CREATED over the full gate, the full sweep, everyday and the --quick companion; mechanism self-test 2 lines.
(c) .= past 200 chars on a scalar box / hash or array element / deref element / $$hardref appends IN PLACE into a private geometric buffer behind a :strbuf MAGIC CELL (RULED by Fable s509 over a growable string in the slot: reads have one chokepoint, stores have none).  Short appends: inline for a box, one lookup for an element (faster than main).  length() of a :strbuf / :memfh scalar AND (s509) of a hash / array element reads the live length.  Operand order = perl's: the index / key first (a variable as a value snapshot when the value could change it -- s509 review F1), then the value, then the element's current text.
Numbers: 200k `$h{k} .= "ab"` 22 s -> 0.05 s; append-shapes.pl every shape linear (probes/append-shapes.tree-c1); review table at 30k (perl / main / tree): build 0.01 / 1.58 / 0.05, match 0.01 / 1.60 / 0.06, copy 0.02 / 1.68 / 0.05, eq 0.01 / 1.86 / 0.06, print 0.04 / 2.48 / 0.86; app-len 2.62 -> 0.08 s after the s509 addition.
Probes = perl: c-alias.pl (50 rows), c-order.pl, c-deref.pl, m4-alias.pl (33), elemlen.pl; Fable's p39/ap.pl (50) + ap2.pl (41): every row = main or = perl except the ONE recorded divergence (ir-spec 3.2: a value that deletes the element or replaces the container -- perl appends to the detached element).
Guards: Pl/t/perf-levers-08.t (16 rows).  Residue filed: #2720 ($_[0] .= in a per-append sub), #2722 (non-length reads after each append snapshot), #2723 (end-anchored regex scans from the start -- main too).
subject: PERF (quadratic `.=` on the GENERAL path): `$h{k} .= X`, `our $g .= X`, `$self->{buf} .= $chunk` still copy the whole string per append -- the s494p census step 2 (constructor test + audit mode) is owed before any in-place append
